overseas_copyright.main_subtitle: A next-generation copyright protection solution that preemptively blocks illegal leaks of digital content and uses AI to analyze patterns and routes to track the responsible parties if a leak occurs.
overseas_copyright.feature1: Difficulty in adopting protection technology due to lack of an in-house platform
overseas_copyright.feature2: Occurrence of illegal copying and leaks during external delivery, inspection, and distribution
overseas_copyright.feature3: Existing DRM is limited to playback control and cannot respond after a leak
overseas_copyright.feature4: Existing forensics are ID mapping-centered, limiting response to modified or reprocessed content
overseas_copyright.s1: AI pattern and route analysis beyond simple ID mapping
overseas_copyright.s2: Similarity-based identification of modified, edited, or re-encoded content
overseas_copyright.s3: Response to AI-generated content, including deepfake music and video detection
overseas_copyright.s4: Automated detection of repetitive and organized leak patterns
overseas_copyright.approach_subtitle: We place AI analysis technology at the center of protection, flexibly integrating proven global DRM and digital forensic technologies to provide copyright protection as 'platform infrastructure' rather than just a 'solution.' DRM serves as the control measure, while AI acts as the core engine for judgment, analysis, and tracking.
overseas_copyright.kf1_description1: Integration with proven overseas DRM technologies
overseas_copyright.kf1_description3: Applicable to web, platform, and B2B delivery environments
overseas_copyright.kf2_description1: Dynamic insertion of identification info by content, session, and distribution target
overseas_copyright.kf2_description2: Forensic design based on AI analysis rather than simple insertion
overseas_copyright.kf3_description1: Automated learning and classification of leak patterns
overseas_copyright.kf3_description2: Detection of repetitive and organized leak behavior
overseas_copyright.kf3_description3: Analyzing 'how and through what routes' leaks occur, not just 'who leaked it'
overseas_copyright.m1_subtitle: For large content companies and platforms
overseas_copyright.m2_subtitle: For content companies without a platform
overseas_copyright.m2_description: Provision of a dedicated protected web-app (White-label)
overseas_copyright.m2_description2: Unified process: Content upload → Protection → Distribution
overseas_copyright.m2_description3: Immediate use without additional platform development

faq.question: How does this differ from existing DRM or forensic solutions?
faq.answer: While traditional methods focus on file protection and post-leak identification, our solution analyzes the leakage behavior and paths using AI. Instead of static mapping, it analyzes user patterns and behaviors to support precise session-level tracking.

faq.question: Is this simply a combination of AI technology and DRM?
faq.answer: No. DRM is merely the control mechanism; the core lies in the AI analysis layer. The AI handles the judgment, tracking, and evidence-gathering processes after a leak occurs, going beyond simple blocking to investigate the circumstances of the leakage.

faq.question: Can the AI analysis results be used as legal evidence?
faq.answer: Yes. By combining watermark/forensic identification, access/distribution logs, and AI pattern analysis results into a single evidence package, we strengthen the structure and consistency required for legal evidence.

faq.question: Can companies without a dedicated distribution platform still benefit from this?
faq.answer: Yes. We provide a 'Dedicated Protection Web App' for companies without their own platforms. This allows for powerful protection even during external transfers, ensuring the same level of security regardless of platform availability.

faq.question: Is it difficult to protect large volumes of content using a web app?
faq.answer: Not at all. The provided web app is an 'Operational Protection Portal,' not just a simple tool. it functions as a dedicated enterprise protection infrastructure, supporting bulk uploads, repeated distribution, user-specific permission management, and the accumulation of leak analysis logs.

faq.question: Does this solution respond to the leakage of Deepfakes or AI-generated content?
faq.answer: Yes, this is our primary focus. Through AI-based similarity analysis and synthetic pattern recognition, we precisely detect modified content—such as deepfake music and video—that is difficult to protect with traditional DRM.

faq.question: We are already using another DRM solution. Do we need to replace it?
faq.answer: Our solution can be implemented as an additional layer while maintaining your existing system. It complements your operations by adding 'post-leakage' analysis capabilities with minimal changes to your current workflow, making it an expansion solution rather than a replacement.

faq.question: What is the difference between your solution and traditional copyright protection companies?
faq.answer: While traditional firms focus on the protection technology (DRM) itself, we provide an AI-powered 'Protection Operations Infrastructure.' We play an expanded role in advanced areas such as platform-agnostic protection, AI-generated content security, and evidence automation.

deepfake-music-detection.title: IRIS - 5
deepfake-music-detection.shortDescription: Protect copyrights by accurately distinguishing between AI-generated music and real music
deepfake-music-detection.whatItSolves: Music streaming platforms and record labels are facing copyright infringement and authenticity verification issues due to the proliferation of AI-generated music. This solution protects the platform's reliability by detecting deepfake music in real time.
keyFeatures: Recognition of various music generation model patterns
useCases: AI-generated music filtering on music streaming platforms
Copyright protection system for record labels
Authenticity verification for music competitions
Quality control for music distributors
deepfake-music-detection.howItWorks: The deep learning-based audio analysis engine analyzes the spectrum, frequency patterns, and generation artifacts of music in real time to determine whether it is AI-generated. It responds to new deepfake techniques by learning the characteristics of various generation models.
deepfake-music-detection.integration: Easy integration with existing platforms is possible with REST API and SDK. Both cloud and on-premise deployments are supported.
deepfake-music-detection.security: All music data is transmitted encrypted and deleted immediately after analysis. It provides an infrastructure that complies with GDPR and personal information protection laws.

faq.question: What AI music generation tools can it detect?
faq.answer: It detects a wide range of major AI music generation tools such as Suno, Udio, and MusicGen, as well as proprietary models. It continuously learns to respond to new generation techniques.

faq.question: What is the real-time processing speed?
faq.answer: It analyzes a 3-minute piece of music in an average of 2 seconds or less. For bulk processing, the speed is optimized by parallel processing.

faq.question: What is the false positive rate?
faq.answer: It currently maintains a high accuracy of less than 2% for false positives and less than 1.5% for false negatives.

deepfake-media-detection.title: IRIS - 6
deepfake-media-detection.shortDescription: Prevents the spread of false information by detecting AI-manipulated images and videos in real time
deepfake-media-detection.whatItSolves: Deepfake videos and images are being abused as a major means of spreading false information on social media and news platforms. This solution secures the reliability of the platform by automatically detecting AI-manipulated content.
keyFeatures: Simultaneous detection of image and video deepfakes
Face swap, Face reenactment pattern recognition
useCases: Content moderation for social media platforms
Fact-checking system for news organizations
Brand protection for corporate PR teams
Authenticity verification of legal/evidence materials
deepfake-media-detection.howItWorks: The CNN-based video analysis model inspects the face area, boundary artifacts, and temporal consistency for each frame. It determines whether it has been manipulated by analyzing GAN-based generation patterns and compression traces.
deepfake-media-detection.integration: It is provided in the form of a web API, Python SDK, and Chrome Extension, and can be directly integrated into a content management system.
deepfake-media-detection.security: Uploaded media is processed in a dedicated isolated environment for analysis and automatically deleted after analysis is complete. It supports end-to-end encryption.

faq.question: Can it also analyze real-time video streams?
faq.answer: Yes, near-real-time detection is possible even in a live streaming environment through frame sampling.

faq.question: What deepfake techniques does it detect?
faq.answer: It detects major deepfake frameworks such as FaceSwap, DeepFaceLab, and First Order Motion Model, as well as the latest Diffusion-based generation models.

faq.question: Is high-resolution video also processed quickly?
faq.answer: 4K video is processed at about 1.5 times the real-time speed with GPU acceleration, and HD video can be processed in near real-time.

cloning-tts.title: LUCY - 5
cloning-tts.shortDescription: Clones a natural voice from a small amount of voice samples for use in various content creation
cloning-tts.whatItSolves: A lot of time and money is spent on casting and recording voice actors for audiobook, advertisement, and e-Learning production. This solution maximizes production efficiency by generating high-quality voice from a small amount of voice samples.
keyFeatures: Multilingual support (Korean, English, Chinese, Japanese, etc.)
useCases: Audiobook and podcast production
Automatic generation of multilingual marketing content
Narration of e-Learning educational content
Game character voice production
cloning-tts.howItWorks: The latest Neural TTS technology learns the timbre, intonation, and speaking style of a voice. The few-shot learning technique enables high-quality cloning with only a small amount of samples, and provides a lightweight model capable of real-time inference.
cloning-tts.integration: It returns a voice file when text is transmitted through the REST API. When deployed on-premise, it is provided in the form of a Docker container.
cloning-tts.security: Voice samples are trained in a customer-dedicated isolated environment, and model weights are stored encrypted. Unauthorized use is prevented by a license management system.

faq.question: How many voice samples are needed?
faq.answer: A minimum of 5 minutes and a recommended 10-15 minutes of clean voice samples are required. The more samples, the better the quality.

faq.question: Can it be used for real-time interactive applications?
faq.answer: Yes, the optimized model generates voice within an average of 0.5 seconds per sentence, making it suitable for real-time conversation systems.

faq.question: Can I also control emotional expressions?
faq.answer: You can control basic emotions such as joy, sadness, anger, and neutral, as well as the strength of intonation, with parameters.

music-generation.title: LUCY - 7
music-generation.shortDescription: Automatically generates music of the desired genre and mood with a text prompt
music-generation.whatItSolves: Video producers and creators spend a lot of time looking for background music that is free of copyright concerns. This solution increases creative efficiency by instantly generating the desired music with just a text description.
keyFeatures: Fine-tuning of genre, tempo, and instruments
Free length setting from 30 seconds to 5 minutes
useCases: YouTube video background music
Advertising and promotion music
Game and app background music
Prototype music sketch
music-generation.howItWorks: The Transformer-based music generation model converts text prompts into musical elements (melody, harmony, rhythm). It is automatically arranged according to the user-specified genre and mood, and supports smooth looping by automatically detecting loop points.
music-generation.integration: Accessible via Web UI and REST API, and the generated music is downloaded in WAV, MP3 format.
music-generation.security: The copyright of the generated music belongs to the user, and the prompt data is deleted after generation is complete.

faq.question: Are there any copyright issues?
faq.answer: All generated music is created with a model that has resolved the copyright issues of the training data, and a commercial use license is included.

faq.question: How long does it take to generate?
faq.answer: A 30-second piece of music takes about 10-15 seconds, and a 3-minute piece takes about 1 minute.

faq.question: Can it imitate a specific artist's style?
faq.answer: To protect copyright, it does not support imitating a specific artist's style, and only provides generation based on genre and mood.

aac-voice-communication.title: BLINGS (AAC)
aac-voice-communication.shortDescription: Converts disordered speech into normal speech in real time
aac-voice-communication.whatItSolves: Patients with speech disorders experience great inconvenience in daily conversation. This solution supports smooth communication by converting disordered speech into clear speech in real time.
keyFeatures: Real-time voice conversion (latency less than 0.3 seconds)
Support for various types of speech disorders
Support for mobile apps and wearable devices
useCases: Communication support for ALS patients
Rehabilitation after laryngeal cancer surgery
Assistant for stroke patients with language disorders
Communication training for children with developmental disabilities
aac-voice-communication.howItWorks: The AI speech recognition engine converts unclear speech into text, and a personalized TTS model regenerates it into a natural voice. It maximizes clarity while preserving the user's original tone of voice.
aac-voice-communication.integration: It supports linkage with mobile apps (iOS/Android), web browsers, and voice amplification devices.
aac-voice-communication.security: All voice data is processed on the device (on-device AI) and is not transmitted to an external server. It is preparing for medical device standard (FDA, MFDS) certification.

faq.question: What types of speech impairments are supported?
faq.answer: We support a wide range of types including Dysarthria, Aphasia, and vocal tremors. Our specialized model is particularly effective at reconstructing the unclear articulation of dysarthria patients into clear speech.

faq.question: Can the user's original voice be maintained?
faq.answer: Yes. Through our personalized voice reconstruction technology, we can restore the user's pre-impairment voice or the most similar tone, allowing them to communicate with a voice that reflects their own identity rather than a generic machine voice.

faq.question: How is sensitive medical and personal information secured?
faq.answer: Utilizing On-Device AI, all voice data is processed instantly within the device without being sent to external servers. This provides a high level of security that complies with HIPAA (U.S. Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act) regulations.

diagnosis-rehabilitation.title: Revocal
diagnosis-rehabilitation.shortDescription: Automatically generates a customized rehabilitation program based on voice diagnosis data
diagnosis-rehabilitation.whatItSolves: After a voice disorder is diagnosed, the design of a rehabilitation program relies heavily on the experience of experts, and it is difficult to customize it for each patient. This solution analyzes diagnostic data to automatically propose an optimal rehabilitation program.
keyFeatures: Creation of a personalized rehabilitation program for each patient
useCases: Voice therapy program in the department of rehabilitation medicine
Digital transformation of speech therapy rooms
Remote voice rehabilitation service
Long-term rehabilitation management in nursing homes
diagnosis-rehabilitation.howItWorks: The voice analysis AI evaluates the type and severity of the disorder from the patient's voice sample and creates a personalized training plan by matching it with the rehabilitation protocols in the database. It dynamically adjusts the program by tracking progress.
diagnosis-rehabilitation.integration: It can be linked with the existing EMR (Electronic Medical Record) system and the HL7 FHIR standard, and can also be used as a standalone web app.
diagnosis-rehabilitation.security: Fully compliant with medical data security standards (HIPAA, Personal Information Protection Act). Patient data is stored encrypted, and access logs are recorded.

faq.question: Can it be used without a medical professional?
faq.answer: Although it provides a diagnostic assistance function, the final diagnosis and treatment plan must be reviewed by a medical professional.

faq.question: What kind of rehabilitation training does it provide?
faq.answer: It provides evidence-based voice rehabilitation protocols such as vocalization training, articulation practice, breathing training, and pitch control in a gamified interface.

faq.question: How is progress monitored?
faq.answer: You can track improvement through weekly/monthly voice evaluation reports and visualized progress charts.

robot-defect-detection.title: Robot Component Defect Detection
robot-defect-detection.titleEn: AI-Powered Zero-Defect Detection for Robot Components
robot-defect-detection.shortDescription: Real-time detection of micro-defects in robot reducers within 1ms using VIB and Distributional Reinforcement Learning.
robot-defect-detection.whatItSolves: This solution addresses the limitations of 'random sampling' in the quality validation of Harmonic Drives (Robo Drive), which is often caused by high physical and computational costs. By repurposing high-speed signal integrity technology for mechanical vibration analysis, our 'Digital Stethoscope' AI inspects every single unit on the production line to eliminate tail risks and safety concerns in the collaborative robot (Cobot) market.
keyFeatures: VIB(Variational Information Bottleneck) based data compression and ultra-high-speed inspection (51x faster processing)
Worst-Case robustness certification via CVaR (Conditional Value at Risk) optimization for extreme environments
Zero-Shot anomaly detection based on 'Golden Master' data (95.9% detection accuracy for unseen defects)
Automated generation of data-driven 'Safety Certificates' for every individual product
useCases: Ultra-high-speed vibration pattern inspection for robot reducers and rotating components
Mathematical robustness guarantee for precision parts under extreme conditions (thermal shock, torque spikes)
Immediate micro-defect detection without the need for prior fault data accumulation
Real-time assembly quality validation for semiconductor wafers, precision molds, and SMT lines
Establishing a digital quality history and safety certification system for all shipped units
robot-defect-detection.howItWorks: Our proprietary AI compresses massive sensor data using VIB technology, reducing inspection time per unit to under 1ms. Instead of optimizing for average performance, we use CVaR to mathematically guarantee normal operation even in the bottom 10% worst-case scenarios, utilizing semi-supervised learning to catch even previously unseen defect types.
robot-defect-detection.integration: Directly interfaces with major industrial robots (FANUC, ABB, KUKA) and integrates with PLC/MES systems via OPC UA and MQTT protocols.
robot-defect-detection.security: Supports On-Device AI strategies for HIPAA compliance; all production data is processed on-premise within an air-gapped environment.

faq.question: Can the detection speed keep up with the production line?
faq.answer: Yes. VIB technology has reduced the inspection time per unit to under 1ms. This is 51 times faster than conventional methods, enabling 100% full inspection without causing bottlenecks on the production line.

faq.question: Is it applicable to new processes with insufficient fault data?
faq.answer: Yes. Our Zero-Shot detection technology requires no fault data accumulation. It can operate immediately using only 'Golden Master' (normal) data and can identify even the most subtle, newly-occurring defects.

faq.question: What environmental factors can be guaranteed?
faq.answer: Through Distributional Reinforcement Learning, we mathematically guarantee that the system operates normally even under 'Worst-Case' conditions, such as sudden torque changes or thermal shocks, and issue safety certificates based on this data.

emotion-recognition.title: Multimodal Emotion Recognition
emotion-recognition.shortDescription: A precise emotion prediction solution that integrates speech, facial expressions, and biosignals to minimize uncertainty.
emotion-recognition.whatItSolves: Relying on a single data source (facial expression or voice alone) often leads to inconsistencies and uncertainty in emotional judgment. This solution utilizes an Evidence Fusion model to process multi-angle sensing data, providing highly reliable emotional state analysis.
keyFeatures: Evidence Fusion Model-based resolution of data inconsistencies
Facial Model expression recognition and Biosignal analysis (Heart Rate, EDA, etc.)
useCases: Stress and mental health monitoring for high-risk professionals
Real-time tracking of agent and customer emotions in contact centers
Intelligent safety control systems (Detection of abnormal behavior and emotions)
Enhanced quality for remote medical/counseling services
emotion-recognition.howItWorks: The system concurrently collects voice data from speech audio tracks, facial expression data via cameras, and biosignals (heart rate, blood pressure, EDA) from wearable devices. Each piece of information is processed through an Evidence Fusion model to offset data uncertainties, ultimately delivering precise and high-confidence emotional insights.
emotion-recognition.integration: Integrates with existing safety management or counseling solutions through standard wearable device interfaces and APIs.
emotion-recognition.security: Supports encrypted data transmission and secure server processing to protect sensitive biometric and facial data.

faq.question: How do you handle cases where different data sources conflict?
faq.answer: The Evidence Fusion algorithm calculates the reliability weights of each data source to derive an optimal emotion value that minimizes uncertainty.

faq.question: What types of biosignals are supported?
faq.answer: It primarily supports Heart Rate, Blood Pressure, and Electrodermal Activity (EDA), with expandability based on device compatibility.

faq.question: Is real-time analysis possible?
faq.answer: Yes, real-time streaming data analysis and output are possible through edge computing and high-performance AI models.
